testroom.name: BOO! The Arena Testroom
testroom.next_up: Implement Doom (112) — Fiendship: passive +2 bonus damage on every win. Simple flat bonus added in the damage section with `FIENDSHIP!` callout.
testroom.after_that: Implement Shade (111) — Haunt: after the first round, opponent takes 1 pre-roll damage each round. Pre-roll tick damage added in `doPreRollSetup`, similar to Shade's Shadow's Meltdown pattern.

feed.summary: Implemented The Mountain King (110) — Beast Mode: doubles now deal 2X damage with a `BEAST MODE!` legendary callout showing the before/after multiplier, using the established `mountainKingTriggered`/`collectKC` pattern from Pudge/Red Hunter.
feed.next_up: Implement Doom (112) — Fiendship: passive +2 bonus damage on every win. Simple flat bonus added in the damage section with `FIENDSHIP!` callout.
feed.after_that: Implement Shade (111) — Haunt: after the first round, opponent takes 1 pre-roll damage each round. Pre-roll tick damage added in `doPreRollSetup`, similar to Shade's Shadow's Meltdown pattern.
feed.roast: Five months to Kickstarter and you're shipping a card whose entire mechanic is "roll doubles, press X" — Rosewater calls that "lenticular design," Garfield calls it "a coin flip with extra steps.

feed.summary: Shade's Shadow pre-roll KO no longer allows rolling to start mid-MELTDOWN! — `B.phase = 'ko-pause'` now prevents `rollReady` from proceeding before `handleKOs()` fires
feed.next_up: Audit the `dmg=0` path for non-empty queues — ability callouts fire at t=2600ms (after 0-damage narration clears), but verify "Round N — X vs Y" narration immediately displays (no stale lock) and roll buttons fire 350ms later with no overlap after the queue drains
feed.after_that: Audit the `doKoSwap` multi-KO chain — when a newly-entered ghost triggers another KO (entry ability KO's the opponent's active ghost), verify `openKoSwap` is not called a second time while the first swap's entry callouts are still playing
feed.roast: Polish cycle. Also known as: admitting the first version shipped unfinished.

feed.summary: `dmg === 0` round-transition narration/button race fixed — roll buttons were going live 500ms before "Round N — X vs Y" could display (narration lock blocked it); increased `totalDmgBeats` from 800ms to 2600ms so the drain callback fires 200ms after the 0-damage narration releases its lock, giving the round announcement a clear slot before buttons activate
feed.next_up: Audit `doPreRollSetup`'s Shade's Shadow Meltdown block — when Shade triggers mid-queue and KOs a ghost, `handleKOs()` returns true from inside `drainAbilityQueue`'s callback; verify the `postRollDone` → KO chain properly parks phase in 'ko-pause' and doesn't double-fire `openKoSwap` if it was already called by the queue callback
feed.after_that: Audit narrator pacing in the dmg=0 path for non-empty queues — ability callouts now fire at t=2600ms (after 0-damage narration clears), but if the queue drains and the callback fires (e.g. at t=5400ms for 1 ability), verify "Round N — X vs Y" narration immediately displays (no stale lock) and then roll buttons fire 350ms later with no overlap
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent an entire cycle teaching the game to count to three before speaking — Rosewater would be proud that your "damage system" needed two thousand milliseconds of therapy just to handle the number zero.

feed.summary: `doPressureSwap` no-KO path now calls `resetRollButtons()` so AFK timer restarts, stale button classes clear, and button state is consistent with every other roll-enabling path
feed.next_up: Audit the `dmg === 0` (dodge) round-transition timing — when the queue is empty, the callback fires at t=800ms, `narrate("Round N")` fires at t=1550ms but is queued behind the still-active "deals 0 damage" narration (held until t=2550ms), so roll buttons go live at t=1900ms while the round announcement text doesn't appear until t=2550ms — a 650ms window where buttons are active but no round context is shown
feed.after_that: Audit `doPreRollSetup`'s Shade's Shadow Meltdown block — when Shade triggers mid-queue and KOs a ghost, `handleKOs()` returns true from inside `drainAbilityQueue`'s callback; verify the `postRollDone` → KO chain properly parks phase in 'ko-pause' and doesn't double-fire `openKoSwap` if it was already called by the queue callback
feed.roast: Congratulations on spending an entire cycle discovering that buttons should act like buttons — Garfield wept.

feed.summary: Triples/Quads/Penta banner no longer overlaps with resolution Beat 1 — `doPostRollAndResolve` now waits 1800ms if EITHER team (not just the second roller) had triples or better
feed.next_up: Moonstone/Lucky Stone resource-grant timing audit — when abilities like Tremor!, Materialization!, or Pollinate! grant resources, `renderBattle()` runs synchronously inside `resolveRound`, visually updating the resource tile BEFORE the ability callout splash plays; the tile update should land AFTER the callout clears, not before it fires
feed.after_that: Narrator pacing — trace all KO→swap→entry→round-narrate chains to ensure no two `narrate()` calls fire within less than 400ms of each other; the drainNarrate system protects sequential calls but if a new `narrate()` fires while one is mid-display, the reader needs the full hold window before the next line appears
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent an entire cycle teaching the game to pause for its own fireworks — Rosewater would call that "solving a problem you invented," but at least Buttons gets her full spotlight moment now.

feed.summary: `resolveRound` now clears the stale roll-narration backlog on entry so damage narration appears in rhythm with Beat 2 instead of 5–7 seconds after HP has already dropped
feed.next_up: Triples/Quads/Penta celebration pacing — when the SECOND player rolls (triggering resolve) and the FIRST player had triples, the banner shows from t=700ms and lasts 1700ms, but `doPostRollAndResolve` fires at t=700+1400=2100ms (if the second player rolled singles/doubles), beating the banner's fade-out by 300ms; Beat 1 dice highlight fires while the banner is still visible; consider bumping the resolve delay to always be 1800ms when isTripleOrBetter was true on EITHER team's roll, not just the resolving team's roll
feed.after_that: Moonstone/Lucky Stone resource-grant timing audit — when abilities grant resources (Tremor!, Materialization!, Pollinate!), the resource tile visually updates immediately via `renderBattle()` synchronously inside `resolveRound` even though the callout splash hasn't played yet; the visual change should land AFTER the callout clears, not before it fires
feed.roast: Congratulations, you finally made the narrator show up to the fight before the patient dies on the table — Rosewater calls that "meeting the bare minimum of player expectation," but sure, let's call it a rhythm fix.

feed.summary: `openKoSwap` multi-ghost picker race fixed — `renderBattle()` (which lights up sideline cards as clickable) now fires 300ms after `narrate()` instead of synchronously before it, so the "who answers the call?" text is visible before picker cards go interactive.
feed.next_up: Audit narrator pacing in rapid-damage sequences — when `dmg === 0` (dodge), `totalDmgBeats` is only 800ms; if a pre-queued ability callout drains at that point, verify the 900ms+1500ms post-drain buffer lands safely after the 1400ms splash window, not during it (a dodge round with WARM BELLY! or HARVEST DANCE! could still show the callout while roll buttons re-enable).
feed.after_that: Audit the `doPressureSwap` auto-pick entry chain for `renderBattle()` ordering — after the PRESSURE! splash (1500ms) and entry callouts finish, `renderBattle()` in the `if (!handleKOs())` path fires synchronously; verify the HP bar update for the newly-entered ghost is visible before any Knight reaction callout covers the arena.
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent a whole cycle discovering that players need to *read words* before they *click things* — truly the kind of breakthrough that keeps Richard Garfield up at night.

feed.summary: `doPressureSwap` now narrates the forced swap in the narrator div (both auto-pick and manual-pick paths), so the PRESSURE! splash is always accompanied by a readable text record identifying the attacker, the ejected ghost, and the incoming replacement.
feed.next_up: Audit the `doKoSwap` multi-ghost picker path — `openKoSwap` fires `narrate("X is down! — who answers the call?")` then immediately calls `renderBattle()` synchronously to mark sideline cards as clickable; verify the "who answers the call?" narration has fully displayed before picker cards become interactive (no 0ms race between narrate and renderBattle that makes the UI interactive before the player reads the prompt).
feed.after_that: Audit narrator pacing in rapid damage sequences — when `dmg === 0` (dodge), `totalDmgBeats` is only 800ms; if an ability callout then queues and drains, verify its 900ms post-drain buffer lands after the 1400ms splash window, not during it (a dodge round with an ability like WARM BELLY! or HARVEST DANCE! could still show the callout while roll buttons re-enable).
feed.roast: One more tooltip and the game basically plays itself. For nobody. Because nobody's reading tooltips.

feed.summary: `doPressureSwap` roll-button race during callout chain fixed — `B.phase` was immediately restored to `'ready'` (or left `'ready'` in the auto-pick path) before showing the PRESSURE! callout, leaving both roll buttons live for the entire 1400ms splash plus all subsequent entry callouts; now parks in `'ko-pause'` and only restores `'ready'` after the full PRESSURE! + entry callout chain completes.
feed.next_up: Audit the `usePressure` auto-pick path for a narration gap — when only one sideline ghost is alive, `doPressureSwap` fires without any "X is down!" or "Pressure!" narration context before the callout; the opponent sees the ghost suddenly swap with no textual explanation in the narrator div before the callout fires. Add a `narrate()` call so the swap is announced in the narrator before the PRESSURE! splash.
feed.after_that: Audit the `doKoSwap` multi-ghost picker path — when `openKoSwap` shows the card picker (multiple survivors), `renderBattle()` is called synchronously to mark sideline cards as clickable; verify the "who answers the call?" narration has fully displayed before the picker cards become interactive (no 0ms race between narrate() and renderBattle() that could make the UI interactive before the player reads the prompt).
feed.roast: Congratulations on spending a full cycle discovering that leaving both roll buttons live during a 1400ms animation is, in fact, bad — Richard Garfield solved input lockout in 1993 but sure, take your time.

feed.summary: Benjamin (203) Magic Touch splash overlap fixed — `commitMoonstone` now waits 1600ms (not 1200ms) before `checkLuckyStones()` when Magic Touch fires, so the MAGIC TOUCH! callout fully clears before the next picker appears
feed.next_up: Narrator pacing audit — multiple `narrate()` calls can fire within ~100ms of each other on round-transition paths (e.g. "X is down!" immediately followed by "Round N — X vs Y" in the KO→swap→entry→narrate chain), visibly flickering the narrator div too fast to read; trace all paths where two `narrate()` calls fire within 400ms and add minimum stagger between them
feed.after_that: Triples/Quads/Penta celebration pacing — verify the banner + screen shake plays for its full dramatic duration before the damage resolution 4-beat sequence begins; if the celebration and the dice-highlight beat can overlap, the big moment gets undercut
feed.roast: Adding 400 milliseconds of delay to fix a visual overlap is the game design equivalent of solving a leaky faucet by putting a bucket under it — Garfield would be proud you shipped a race condition fix that's literally just "wait longer.

feed.summary: `drainAbilityQueue` global 900ms→1500ms root-cause fix — callback now fires 100ms after the last splash clears instead of 500ms before it, eliminating callout/UI overlap across all drain paths; removed v111 TIE-path 600ms workaround that compensated for this exact gap
feed.next_up: Benjamin (203) Magic Touch — `showAbilityCallout('MAGIC TOUCH!')` fires then `checkLuckyStones()`/`showMoonstoneChoice` is called 1200ms later via a direct setTimeout (not through the queue), still 200ms before the 1400ms splash clears; branch the delay to 1600ms when Magic Touch fires
feed.after_that: Narrator pacing audit — if multiple `narrate()` calls fire within 100ms of each other (e.g. "X is down!" immediately followed by "Round N — X vs Y"), the narrator div will visibly flicker between messages too fast to read; check all round-transition paths for stacked narrate() calls and add minimum 400ms stagger between them
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent a whole cycle discovering that "fire the callback after the animation finishes" is not, in fact, a radical design insight — it's what the code should have done since v1, and Skaff Elias would weep that it took 111 versions of duct tape to get there.

feed.summary: `lF.ko` roll-button race fixed — round narration now fires 350ms before roll buttons enable, matching the no-KO path's breathing-room pattern and closing the last path where buttons went live simultaneously with the round announcement
feed.next_up: Audit the `postRollDone` → `handleKOs()` path at line 3278 — when Shade's Shadow KOs mid-queue, `handleKOs()` returns `true` and `postRollDone` returns early; verify the path that reaches `handleKOs()` there (after moonstone/lucky stone flow) still narrates before enabling, and that the `lF.ko` KO landing at t+1800ms doesn't leave `highlightWinnerDice` glow still animating when the KO swap modal appears
feed.after_that: Audit narrator stagger in rapid damage sequences — when `dmg === 0` (dodge), `totalDmgBeats` is only 800ms; if an ability callout then queues and drains, verify its 900ms post-drain buffer lands after the 1400ms splash window, not during it
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent an entire cycle teaching a button to count to 350 — Garfield redesigned the mana system in less time than it took you to add a third of a second of delay.

feed.summary: `openKoSwap` all-swaps-done path now fires `narrate("Round N")` BEFORE enabling roll buttons (with 350ms delay), so buttons never go live while the entry or round narration is still visible — matching the v110 no-KO pattern
feed.next_up: Audit the `drainAbilityQueue` KO path (`lF.ko` branch, t+1800ms) — `highlightWinnerDice` fires at t+10ms and `handleKOs()` at t+1800ms; verify tiebreaker dice glow doesn't still animate when the KO swap modal appears, and that the `if (!handleKOs())` immediate-ready path at line 4321-4325 also gets the 350ms narrate-first delay (it currently fires `B.phase='ready'` + `resetRollButtons()` + `narrate()` all at once with no delay)
feed.after_that: Audit narrator pacing in the KO auto-pick chain — `openKoSwap` fires "X is down! Y steps up!" via `narrate()`, then 800ms later `doKoSwap` fires `triggerEntry` which calls `narrate("[Y] enters the arena!")` at t=0; since the first narrate's 1800ms lock won't expire until t=1800ms, the entry narrate at t=800ms queues properly — but verify the ghost HP bar update from `renderBattle()` in `doKoSwap` (which fires at t=800ms) is visible before any entry callout splash covers the arena
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent a whole cycle making sure a text box disappears before a button appears — Richard Garfield solved the internet with cardboard and you're out here solving a race condition with a setTimeout.

feed.summary: `drainNarrate` now holds its lock for the full 1800ms even for the last/only item, so narrator lines like "X is down!" can no longer be stomped by "Y enters the arena!" arriving 800ms later
feed.next_up: Audit `openKoSwap`'s all-swaps-done path — `resetRollButtons()` fires immediately alongside `narrate("Round N")`, meaning roll buttons pulse and become clickable while the round-narration + entry narration are still draining; consider delaying `B.phase = 'ready'` + `resetRollButtons()` until the narrator queue is clear (or at least a fixed 1800ms after the last swap's entry narration)
feed.after_that: Audit the `drainAbilityQueue` KO path (`lF.ko` branch) — `highlightWinnerDice` fires at t+10ms then `handleKOs()` at t+1800ms; verify the tiebreaker dice glow finishes before the KO swap modal appears, and that no narration from `handleKOs` overlaps with the still-draining ability queue
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent a whole cycle teaching the narrator not to interrupt itself — a lesson most humans learn by age four.

feed.summary: TIE-path roll buttons now wait for the last tie-round ability callout to fully clear (600ms wrapper in drain callback) before `B.phase = 'ready'`
feed.next_up: Audit `Benjamin (203) Magic Touch` — `showAbilityCallout('MAGIC TOUCH!')` fires then `checkLuckyStones()`/`showMoonstoneChoice` is called 1200ms later, still 200ms before the 1400ms splash clears; branch the delay to 1600ms when Magic Touch fires
feed.after_that: `drainAbilityQueue` global 900ms callback delay — since it fires 500ms before the last splash clears, ALL drain callbacks are slightly early; consider bumping from 900ms → 1500ms globally and removing the per-path `setTimeout` workarounds for a cleaner, more maintainable fix
feed.roast: Polish cycle. Also known as: admitting the first version shipped unfinished.

feed.summary: No-KO round transition — `narrate("Round N")` now fires 350ms before `resetRollButtons()` instead of simultaneously, so the round announcement is readable before roll buttons activate
feed.next_up: Audit narrator pacing in the KO chain — `openKoSwap` narrates "[Ghost] is down!" then immediately `doKoSwap` fires (800ms auto-pick path) which calls `triggerEntry` which narrates "[New Ghost] enters the arena!" — check if both lines get their full 1800ms hold in `drainNarrate`, or if the entry narration stomps the KO narration before the player can read it
feed.after_that: Audit the `lF.ko` (KO path, 1800ms) branch of the same `drainAbilityQueue` callback — verify `highlightWinnerDice` at t+10ms and `handleKOs()` at t+1800ms produce clean visual separation, and that the KO path's `if (!handleKOs())` fallback (currently dead code in practice) is safe if somehow reached
feed.roast: Congratulations, you spent an entire cycle teaching the game to pause for breath between sentences — Garfield solved that in Alpha with a little thing called "reading the card.

feed.summary: `doKoSwap` entry breathing room fixed — 0ms fallback delay → 800ms so "[Ghost] enters the arena!" is readable before the next KO picker or roll buttons fire
feed.next_up: Audit the `drainAbilityQueue` callback timing — `highlightWinnerDice` fires at t+10ms then KO check fires at t+750ms/t+1800ms; verify the tiebreaker dice glow isn't still animating when the KO swap picker appears, and that the round narration ("Round N — X vs Y") in the no-KO path has enough breathing room before roll buttons enable

feed.summary: Second-team roll no longer stomps pre-roll callouts — `B.preRollCalloutEndTime` records when the first click's callouts finish, and the second team waits for whatever time remains before rolling.
feed.next_up: Audit the KO → swap → entry chain timing: verify that `openKoSwap` doesn't show the swap modal while a narration or callout is still live, and that the entry effects after `doKoSwap` complete before roll buttons re-enable — specifically the multi-KO chain where a KO in `doKoSwap`'s entry triggers another `handleKOs` call.
feed.after_that: Audit `drainAbilityQueue` callback timing — the `highlightWinnerDice` fires at t=10ms then the 750ms/1800ms KO check fires; verify the tiebreaker dice glow isn't still visible when the KO swap picker appears, and that the roll buttons don't re-enable before all post-round narration has had breathing room.
feed.roast: Nice, you finally stopped letting the second roll bulldoze through callouts like Timber through a haunted forest — too bad Richard Garfield solved turn priority in 1993.

feed.summary: Fixed `startBattle` entry-stagger timing: synchronous `abilitySplash.active` check always returned false (callouts fire async), so Red/Blue entry delays were always 300ms — Blue's callout stomped Red's; now uses `triggerEntry()` return count × 1500ms for correct spacing.
feed.next_up: Audit `doPreRollSetup` pacing — verify the `preRollCallouts` drain fully completes (including all 1500ms-spaced splashes) before roll buttons re-enable, checking specifically the path where both Red and Blue each have pre-roll abilities in the same round.
feed.after_that: Audit the round-transition path in `drainAbilityQueue` callback — the `highlightWinnerDice` fires at t=10ms then the 750ms/1800ms KO check fires; verify the tiebreaker dice glow isn't still visible when the KO swap picker appears, and that roll buttons don't pulse before post-round narration has a moment to breathe.
feed.roast: Congratulations on discovering that async code runs asynchronously — Garfield figured that out in '93, but sure, take your victory lap.

feed.summary: `doPressureSwap` PRESSURE! callout no longer gets stomped by entry effects — delayed `triggerEntry` by 1500ms so the PRESSURE! splash fully displays before LEVIATHAN!/BIG TARGET!/etc. starts playing.
feed.next_up: Audit the auto-swap path in `doPressureSwap` (when `aliveSideline.length === 1`, line 2568-2570) — it calls `doPressureSwap` directly with no narration or callout at all, so even the PRESSURE! splash is silently skipped when there's only one valid incoming ghost; should at least fire the callout before the auto-swap resolves.
feed.after_that: Full combo playtesting pass — specifically Selene doubles + Moonstone in the same round (does the Moonstone prompt appear cleanly after HEART OF THE HILLS! drains?), and verify Death Howl Pressure with Nerina or Timpleton as the entering ghost (PRESSURE! → 1500ms → LEVIATHAN!/BIG TARGET! → entry damage → handleKOs) now sequences correctly end-to-end.
feed.roast: That's not a fix. That's a bandaid on a bandaid. Buttons has more structural integrity.

feed.summary: All 14 `checkKnightEffects` calls in `resolveRound`'s pre-cinematic game-state section now use a `collectKC()` helper that captures Knight callouts in temp-queue-mode; Sylvia PORPOISE! callouts moved to the cinematic section — so every Knight HEAVY AIR!/RETRIBUTION! reaction now plays sequentially at the end of the ability queue instead of firing synchronously at t=0 (stomping each other or getting stomped by the first queued ability, especially fatal for Sylvia dodges where dmg=0 makes the queue fire at only 800ms).
feed.next_up: Full combo playtesting pass — specifically Selene doubles + Moonstone in the same round (does the Moonstone prompt appear cleanly after HEART OF THE HILLS! clears via the drain callback?), and verify the new Knight callout ordering (Dart PLUNDER! → round ends → HEAVY AIR! at tail of queue) feels correct and doesn't create a long awkward pause after the last ability if multiple Knight reactions fire.
feed.after_that: Audit the Tweak and Twonk/Jimmy/Maximo `checkKnightEffects` calls in the TIE path (lines 3872, 3884, 3896) — these ARE in `abilityQueueMode=true` context so they correctly queue, but verify that the TIE path's `drainAbilityQueue` callback includes the Knight callouts in the drain sequence (they should since queue mode is set before the calls and drained after, but the queue ordering should put WARM BELLY!/CHIRP!/NAP! before HEAVY AIR!/RETRIBUTION!).
feed.roast: Congrats on doing what the code should have done from day one. September claps slowly.

feed.summary: BLACKOUT! callout no longer gets stomped by post-roll ability queue — collected into `blackoutCallouts[]` and prepended to the cinematic queue so it always plays fully before PLUNDER!/HARVEST DANCE!/etc.
feed.next_up: Full combo playtesting pass — specifically Selene doubles + Moonstone in the same round (does the Moonstone prompt appear cleanly after HEART OF THE HILLS! clears via the drain callback?), and Smudge BLACKOUT! + Knight Light/Terror to verify the newly-queued callout correctly chains to HEAVY AIR!/RETRIBUTION! if a Knight is active.

feed.roast: One more tooltip and the game basically plays itself. For nobody. Because nobody's reading tooltips.

BLACKOUT! should be spliced into the front of the post-roll ability queue instead.
